instruction: Open the Gaussian Blur filter dialog in GIMP.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent dismissed color profile dialog, navigated Filters > Light and Shadow > Vignette, successfully opened the Vignette filter dialog in 8 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menu hierarchy, find specific filters in submenus, dismiss dialogs, interact with GIMP UI
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the same menu navigation capability but targeting a different filter category (Blur instead of Light and Shadow), requiring the agent to navigate to Filters > Blur > Gaussian Blur.
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Gaussian Blur dialog via Filters > Blur > Gaussian Blur. Evaluator quits GIMP to flush action-history, then checks for 'filters-gaussian-blur' in the history file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads GIMP action-history file via vm_command_line, which logs filter activations including 'filters-gaussian-blur'
Postconfig properly quits GIMP (Esc -> Ctrl+Q -> dismiss save dialog) to flush action-history to disk before reading
Metric check_include_exclude correctly receives rules dict directly and checks for 'filters-gaussian-blur' in output
Full instruction coverage: single requirement (open Gaussian Blur dialog) is fully verified by checking action-history
Minor: exclude terms ['error', 'failed', 'not found'] are unlikely to appear in GIMP action-history but are unnecessary noise checks
